clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope —  Requirements for masonry cement to be used for all general purposes where mortars for masonry are required. Masonry cement is, however, not intended for use in structural concrete, for flooring and foundation work or for reinforced and prestressed concrete works. SUMMARY OF IS 3466 : 1988  MASONRY CEMENT (Second Revision)
